items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Chester, Charlie, and myself, and him.

ctx.x: Well, Mud Carter and Mud Carey are two different guys. Yeah, I know both of them.

Mud Carter's a slender, tall guy. He's a bull guy. He's a jack cattle hood, bunch of youngster then. He picked up me, Chester, Charlie, and let me see who else he had. Chester, Charlie, and myself, and him. Who are we at on clarinet? We're at the rubber show bar. Yeah. Usually, when the rubber show comes through. Yeah, yeah. What's Chester's play? It was Chester and Charlie, what is when you first come in the band? Chester's. It was Chester and Charlie and me when you first come in the band. We used to pick you…
